title: admin.messaging().sendMulticast is not a function after upgrading firebase-admin to v13
symptoms: TypeError: admin.messaging(...).sendMulticast is not a function
sendToDevice, sendToTopic, and sendAll are also undefined
Push code broke on an npm update with no other change
cause: firebase-admin 13.0.0 removed the FCM methods built on the legacy HTTP API, which Google shut down, including sendAll, sendMulticast, sendToDevice, sendToDeviceGroup, sendToTopic and sendToCondition.
fix: Use send for one message and sendEachForMulticast or sendEach for batches, with the HTTP v1 message shape.
